integrity: The proof is analytic; checker.py checks symbolic identities and fixed-point numeric regressions. A self-review is not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact result only for homogeneous NIMFA deterministic equilibria on connected four-vertex three-edge undirected trees. Does not assert finite-state SIS stationary/metastable prevalence, graph-general dominance, field epidemiology or historical priority certainty. Full Li et al. (2012) inaccessible in the present comparison.
title: A unique endemic-prevalence reversal between the two four-vertex trees
